<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://unpkg.com" crossorigin>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://www.googletagmanager.com">
    <title>Interactive Middle-earth Map — LOTR, Hobbit & Silmarillion</title>
    <meta name="description" content="An interactive map of Middle-earth: 128 events from The Lord of the Rings, The Hobbit and The Silmarillion, with journey paths and a satellite view.">
    <link rel="canonical" href="https://middle-earth-interactive-map.web.app/">
    <link rel="icon" href="favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
    <meta property="og:type" content="website">
    <meta property="og:title" content="Interactive Middle-earth Map — LOTR, Hobbit & Silmarillion">
    <meta property="og:description" content="An interactive map of Middle-earth: 128 events from The Lord of the Rings, The Hobbit and The Silmarillion, with journey paths and a satellite view.">
    <meta property="og:url" content="https://middle-earth-interactive-map.web.app/">
    <meta property="og:image" content="https://middle-earth-interactive-map.web.app/og-image.jpg">
    <meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">
    <meta property="og:image:height" content="630">
    <meta property="og:image:alt" content="Map of Middle-earth on aged parchment, showing the Shire, Rohan, Gondor and Mordor">
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
    <meta name="twitter:title" content="Interactive Middle-earth Map — LOTR, Hobbit & Silmarillion">
    <meta name="twitter:description" content="An interactive map of Middle-earth: 128 events from The Lord of the Rings, The Hobbit and The Silmarillion, with journey paths and a satellite view.">
    <meta name="twitter:image" content="https://middle-earth-interactive-map.web.app/og-image.jpg">
    <meta name="twitter:image:alt" content="Map of Middle-earth on aged parchment, showing the Shire, Rohan, Gondor and Mordor">
    <script type="application/ld+json">
    {
        "@context": "https://schema.org",
        "@type": "WebSite",
        "name": "Middle-earth Interactive Map",
        "url": "https://middle-earth-interactive-map.web.app/",
        "description": "An interactive map of Tolkien's Middle-earth with events from across the legendarium.",
        "image": {
            "@type": "ImageObject",
            "url": "https://middle-earth-interactive-map.web.app/map-of-middle-earth.jpg",
            "width": 1600,
            "height": 900,
            "caption": "Map of Middle-earth on aged parchment, showing the Shire, Rohan, Gondor and Mordor"
        },
        "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Fraser Marlow",
            "url": "https://github.com/frasermarlow"
        }
    }
    </script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        .visually-hidden {
            position: absolute;
            width: 1px; height: 1px;
            padding: 0; margin: -1px;
            overflow: hidden;
            clip: rect(0,0,0,0);
            white-space: nowrap;
            border: 0;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Georgia, serif;
            background: #1a1a1a;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        #map {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            background: #2c2418;
        }

        /* Legend Panel */
        #nav-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 44px;
            z-index: 1100;
            background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.92);
            border-bottom: 1px solid #5a4a36;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 20px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
        }
        .nav-link {
            color: #8b7355;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 13px;
            padding: 6px 14px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
        }
        .nav-link:hover, .nav-link.active {
            color: #e8d9b0;
            background: rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.2);
        }
        .nav-title {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: #e8d9b0;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        #nav-bar > .nav-link:first-child { justify-self: start; }
        .nav-right { justify-self: end; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; }
        @media (max-width: 500px) {
            .nav-title { display: none; }
        }
        #legend {
            position: absolute;
            top: 60px;
            right: 16px;
            z-index: 1000;
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.95);
            border: 2px solid #8b7355;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 16px;
            color: #d4c5a9;
            max-width: 280px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            max-height: calc(100vh - 32px);
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding-bottom: 120px;
        }

        #legend h2 {
            font-size: 16px;
            color: #e8d9b0;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #8b7355;
            padding-bottom: 8px;
            padding-right: 32px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            position: relative;
        }

        #legend-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: -4px;
            right: 0;
            background: none;
            border: 1px solid #8b7355;
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: #a89070;
            font-size: 18px;
            cursor: pointer;
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            line-height: 1;
            transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
        }

        #legend-close:hover {
            color: #f0e6cc;
            border-color: #d4c5a9;
        }

        .legend-category {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .legend-category-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 6px 0;
            user-select: none;
        }

        .legend-category-header:hover {
            color: #f0e6cc;
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin-right: 8px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .legend-category-label {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: bold;
            flex-grow: 1;
        }

        .legend-toggle {
            font-size: 11px;
            opacity: 0.7;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }

        .legend-items {
            margin-left: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #b8a88a;
        }

        .legend-item {
            padding: 3px 0;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: color 0.2s;
        }

        .legend-item:hover {
            color: #f0e6cc;
        }

        .legend-category.disabled .legend-dot {
            opacity: 0.3;
        }

        .legend-category.disabled .legend-category-label {
            opacity: 0.4;
            text-decoration: line-through;
        }

        .legend-category.disabled .legend-items {
            display: none;
        }

        #collapse-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: 60px;
            right: 16px;
            z-index: 1001;
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.95);
            border: 2px solid #8b7355;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #d4c5a9;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 14px;
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
        }

        #collapse-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(60, 48, 30, 0.95);
            border-color: #d4c5a9;
        }

        .menu-icon {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
        }

        .menu-icon span {
            display: block;
            width: 16px;
            height: 2px;
            background: #d4c5a9;
            border-radius: 1px;
        }

        /* Custom marker styles */
        .event-marker {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .event-marker:hover {
            transform: scale(1.3);
            box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 20px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
        }

        /* Popup styling */
        .leaflet-popup-content-wrapper {
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.97);
            color: #d4c5a9;
            border: 2px solid #8b7355;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-family: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Georgia, serif;
        }

        .leaflet-popup-tip {
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.97);
            border: 1px solid #8b7355;
        }

        .leaflet-popup-close-button {
            color: #d4c5a9 !important;
        }

        .popup-title {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #e8d9b0;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .popup-book {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #a89070;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .popup-description {
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            color: #c8b898;
        }

        .popup-characters {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #a89070;
            margin-top: 8px;
            border-top: 1px solid #6b5b45;
            padding-top: 6px;
        }

        .popup-more {
            font-size: 12px;
            margin-top: 8px;
            padding-top: 6px;
            border-top: 1px solid #6b5b45;
        }
        .popup-more a { color: #c9a435; text-decoration: none; }
        .popup-more a:hover { color: #e8d9b0; text-decoration: underline; }

        /* Leaflet controls theming */
        .leaflet-control-zoom a {
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.95) !important;
            color: #d4c5a9 !important;
            border-color: #8b7355 !important;
        }

        .leaflet-control-zoom a:hover {
            background: rgba(60, 48, 30, 0.95) !important;
        }

        /* Scrollbar styling for legend */
        #legend::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
        }

        #legend::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: transparent;
        }

        #legend::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #8b7355;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        /* Journey paths — marching ants */
        @keyframes march {
            to { stroke-dashoffset: -20; }
        }

        .journey-path {
            animation: march 0.67s linear infinite;
        }

        /* Journey legend section */
        .legend-divider {
            border: none;
            border-top: 1px solid #8b7355;
            margin: 10px 0 8px;
        }

        .legend-journeys-title {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #a89070;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .legend-section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .legend-section-header .legend-journeys-title {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        .legend-section-toggle {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #8b7355;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
            background: none;
            border: 1px solid #5a4a36;
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 2px 7px;
            font-family: inherit;
            transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
        }

        .legend-section-toggle:hover {
            color: #e8d9b0;
            border-color: #8b7355;
            background: rgba(90, 74, 54, 0.4);
        }

        .journey-toggle {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 5px 0;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
            transition: color 0.2s;
        }

        .journey-toggle:hover {
            color: #f0e6cc;
        }

        .journey-toggle.disabled {
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        .journey-line {
            width: 24px;
            height: 3px;
            margin-right: 8px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            border-top: 3px dashed;
        }

        .journey-label {
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .coord-toggle-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 8px 0 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
        }

        .coord-toggle-switch {
            width: 32px;
            height: 18px;
            border-radius: 9px;
            background: #5a4a36;
            position: relative;
            margin-right: 8px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        .coord-toggle-switch::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 2px;
            left: 2px;
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #8b7355;
            transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s;
        }

        .coord-toggle-row.active .coord-toggle-switch {
            background: #6a9f5b;
        }

        .coord-toggle-row.active .coord-toggle-switch::after {
            transform: translateX(14px);
            background: #d4c5a9;
        }

        .coord-toggle-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #a89070;
            transition: color 0.2s;
        }

        .coord-toggle-row.active .coord-toggle-label {
            color: #d4c5a9;
        }

        /* Instructions toast */
        #toast {
            position: absolute;
            /* Sits above #map-controls, which now owns the bottom-centre band */
            bottom: 66px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            z-index: 1000;
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.92);
            border: 1px solid #8b7355;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 10px 20px;
            color: #d4c5a9;
            font-size: 13px;
            opacity: 1;
            transition: opacity 1s ease;
            pointer-events: none;
            text-align: center;
        }

        #toast.hidden {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        /* Splash overlay */
        #splash-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 2000;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
        }
        #splash-overlay.hidden {
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .splash-card {
            background: #2c2418;
            border: 2px solid #8b7355;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 32px 28px 24px;
            max-width: 480px;
            width: 90%;
            color: #d4c5a9;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .splash-card .splash-preview {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            margin: 0 0 16px;
            border: 1px solid #5a4a36;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        /* Keep the preview present but short when there is little vertical room,
           so the Enter button stays reachable without scrolling. */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            .splash-card .splash-preview {
                height: 92px;
                margin-bottom: 12px;
                object-fit: cover;
                object-position: center 45%;
            }
        }
        .splash-card h2 {
            color: #e8d9b0;
            font-size: 22px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        .splash-card p {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        .splash-card ul {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 0;
            margin: 0 0 16px;
        }
        .splash-card ul li {
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            padding: 3px 0 3px 16px;
            position: relative;
        }
        .splash-card ul li::before {
            content: '\00b7';
            position: absolute;
            left: 2px;
            color: #8b7355;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        .splash-card .splash-disclaimer {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #8b7355;
            margin-top: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            font-style: italic;
        }
        .splash-btn {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #c9a435;
            color: #1a1a1a;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: bold;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }
        .splash-btn:hover {
            background: #d4b445;
        }

        /* Map controls (bottom centre) */
        #map-controls {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 16px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            z-index: 1001;
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .map-ctrl {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 7px;
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.95);
            border: 2px solid #8b7355;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #d4c5a9;
            padding: 9px 14px;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 13px;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-decoration: none;
            white-space: nowrap;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
        }
        .map-ctrl:hover {
            background: rgba(60, 48, 30, 0.95);
            border-color: #d4c5a9;
            color: #e8d9b0;
        }
        .map-ctrl.active {
            border-color: #c9a435;
            color: #e8d9b0;
        }
        /* Clear the wrapped copyright line on narrow screens */
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            #map-controls { bottom: 44px; gap: 6px; }
            .map-ctrl { font-size: 12px; padding: 8px 11px; }
            /* The bar sits higher here, so lift the hint above it */
            #toast { bottom: 92px; }
        }

        /* Info button */
        #info-btn {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 32px;
            right: 16px;
            z-index: 1000;
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.9);
            border: 1px solid #8b7355;
            color: #8b7355;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-family: Georgia, serif;
            font-style: italic;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
        }
        #info-btn:hover {
            color: #e8d9b0;
            border-color: #d4c5a9;
        }

        /* Copyright disclaimer */
        #map-copyright {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 8px;
            right: 16px;
            z-index: 1000;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: #8b7355;
            opacity: 0.7;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Distance measure tool */
        .measure-active #map { cursor: crosshair; }

        #coord-display {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 24px;
            left: 16px;
            z-index: 1000;
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.95);
            border: 2px solid #8b7355;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            color: #d4c5a9;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-family: monospace;
            pointer-events: none;
            display: none;
        }

        #measure-display {
            position: absolute;
            /* 72px, not 60px: at 60 it clipped the coordinate readout below it */
            bottom: 72px;
            left: 16px;
            z-index: 1000;
            background: rgba(44, 36, 24, 0.95);
            border: 2px solid #8b7355;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            color: #d4c5a9;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-family: monospace;
            pointer-events: none;
            display: none;
        }

        /* Mobile stack: #map-controls sits higher here, so the two readouts
           move above it. Must come after the rules it overrides — same
           specificity, so source order is what decides. */
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            #coord-display { bottom: 88px; }
            #measure-display { bottom: 135px; }
        }
    </style>
    <script>
        // The analytics module below is deferred, so it runs after the page
        // script. Queue anything fired during load and flush it on init.
        window._trackQueue = [];
        window.track = (name, params) => window._trackQueue.push([name, params]);
    </script>
    <script type="module">
        import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.12.0/firebase-app.js";
        import { getAnalytics, logEvent } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.12.0/firebase-analytics.js";

        const firebaseConfig = {
            apiKey: "AIzaSyCp2XeX3C6nu19X1-f3gZRX9HT_BBxg-Fo",
            authDomain: "middle-earth-interactive-map.firebaseapp.com",
            projectId: "middle-earth-interactive-map",
            storageBucket: "middle-earth-interactive-map.firebasestorage.app",
            messagingSenderId: "590463727876",
            appId: "1:590463727876:web:f8bd2c82420a94d44cb851",
            measurementId: "G-LMZ2Z5W05J"
        };

        const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);

        // Only report from the live site. Without this, localhost and
        // tunnel previews write dev traffic into the production property.
        const ANALYTICS_HOSTS = [
            "middle-earth-interactive-map.web.app",
            "middle-earth-interactive-map.firebaseapp.com"
        ];
        if (ANALYTICS_HOSTS.includes(location.hostname)) {
            const analytics = getAnalytics(app);
            const queued = window._trackQueue;
            window.track = (name, params = {}) => logEvent(analytics, name, params);
            queued.forEach(([name, params]) => window.track(name, params));
        } else {
            window.track = () => {};
        }
    </script>
</head>
<body>
    <h1 class="visually-hidden">Interactive Map of Middle-earth</h1>
    <nav id="nav-bar">
        <a href="/" class="nav-link active">🗺︎ <span data-i18n="nav.map">Map</span></a>
        <span class="nav-title" data-i18n="nav.siteTitle">Middle-earth</span>
        <span class="nav-right">
            <a href="timeline.html" class="nav-link">⏳︎ <span data-i18n="nav.timeline">Timeline</span></a>
            <a href="/places/" class="nav-link">📍︎ <span data-i18n="nav.places">Places</span></a>
            <a href="about.html" class="nav-link">📜︎ <span data-i18n="nav.about">About</span></a>
        </span>
    </nav>
    <main>
    <div id="map"></div>

    <div id="legend">
        <h2><span data-i18n="legend.title">Events of Middle-earth</span><button id="legend-close">×</button></h2>
        <div id="legend-content"></div>
    </div>

    <button id="collapse-btn"><div class="menu-icon"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div> <span data-i18n="legend.menuButton">Legend</span></button>

    <div id="measure-display"></div>
    <div id="toast" data-i18n="map.toast">Scroll to zoom · Drag to pan · Click markers for details</div>

    <div id="splash-overlay" class="hidden">
        <div class="splash-card">
            <h2 data-i18n="splash.heading">Welcome to Middle-earth</h2>
            <img class="splash-preview"
                 src="map-of-middle-earth.jpg"
                 srcset="map-of-middle-earth-800.jpg 800w, map-of-middle-earth.jpg 1600w"
                 sizes="(max-width: 560px) 90vw, 424px"
                 width="1600" height="900"
                 alt="Map of Middle-earth on aged parchment, showing the Shire, the Misty Mountains, Rohan, Gondor and Mordor">
            <p data-i18n="splash.intro">An interactive map of Tolkien’s Middle-earth, with events from across the legendarium plotted as markers.</p>
            <ul>
                <li data-i18n="splash.tip1">Click markers to read about key events</li>
                <li data-i18n="splash.tip2">Use the Legend panel to filter by book or toggle journey paths</li>
                <li data-i18n="splash.tip3">Enable “Measure distance” in the Legend to measure between two points</li>
                <li data-i18n-html="splash.tip4Html">Hit <a href="timeline.html?play=1" style="color:#c9a435;">Play the story</a> to watch all 128 events unfold in order</li>
            </ul>
            <p class="splash-disclaimer" data-i18n="splash.disclaimer">The base map image is sourced from the internet and is used here for fan/educational purposes. We do not claim copyright over the map artwork.</p>
            <button class="splash-btn" id="splash-enter" data-i18n="splash.enter">Enter Middle-earth</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div id="map-controls">
        <button id="sat-btn" class="map-ctrl" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><span id="sat-btn-icon">🛰︎</span> <span id="sat-btn-label" data-i18n="controls.satellite">Satellite</span></button>
        <a id="story-btn" class="map-ctrl" href="timeline.html?play=1">▶︎ <span data-i18n="controls.playStory">Play the story</span></a>
    </div>

    <button id="info-btn" title="About this map" data-i18n-attr="title:controls.infoTitle">i</button>
    <div id="map-copyright" data-i18n="map.copyright">Map artwork is not owned by this project and is used for fan/educational purposes only.</div>
    </main>

    <script src="i18n/i18n.js"></script>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
    <script src="data.js"></script>
    <script src="place-pages.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Events, COLORS, CATEGORY_LABELS, CATEGORY_ICONS, FELLOWSHIP_PATH,
        // JOURNEYS, IMG_W, IMG_H loaded from data.js

        // ── Helper: pixel coords → Leaflet coords ──────
        function toLatLng(px, py) {
            return [py, px];
        }

        // ── Map Setup ───────────────────────────────────
        const MapCRS = L.Util.extend({}, L.CRS.Simple, {
            transformation: new L.Transformation(1, 0, 1, 0)
        });

        const map = L.map('map', {
            crs: MapCRS,
            minZoom: -4,
            maxZoom: 3,
            zoomSnap: 0.25,
            zoomDelta: 0.5,
            wheelPxPerZoomLevel: 120,
            attributionControl: false
        });

        const bounds = [[0, 0], [IMG_H, IMG_W]];
        const tileOpts = {
            minZoom: -4,
            maxZoom: 3,
            maxNativeZoom: 0,
            minNativeZoom: -2,
            zoomOffset: 2,
            tileSize: 256,
            noWrap: true,
            bounds: bounds
        };
        const mapTiles = L.tileLayer('tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.jpg', tileOpts).addTo(map);
        const satTiles = L.tileLayer('tiles-sat/{z}/{x}/{y}.jpg', tileOpts);
        map.fitBounds(bounds);
        const PAD = Math.max(IMG_W, IMG_H);
        map.setMaxBounds([[-PAD, -PAD], [IMG_H + PAD, IMG_W + PAD]]);

        // ── Create Markers ──────────────────────────────
        const categoryLayers = {
            silmarillion: L.layerGroup(),
            hobbit: L.layerGroup(),
            fellowship: L.layerGroup(),
            towers: L.layerGroup(),
            king: L.layerGroup(),
            appendix: L.layerGroup()
        };

        events.forEach(evt => {
            const latlng = toLatLng(evt.px, evt.py);
            const color = COLORS[evt.category];
            const icon = L.divIcon({
                className: '',
                html: `<div class="event-marker" style="
                    width: 22px; height: 22px;
                    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, ${color}, ${darken(color, 40)});
                ">${CATEGORY_ICONS[evt.category]}</div>`,
                iconSize: [22, 22],
                iconAnchor: [11, 11],
                popupAnchor: [0, -14]
            });

            const marker = L.marker(latlng, { icon })
                .bindPopup(`
                    <div style="max-width: 260px;">
                        <div class="popup-title">${evt.name}</div>
                        <div class="popup-book">${t('books.' + evt.category, CATEGORY_LABELS[evt.category])}</div>
                        <div class="popup-description">${evt.description}</div>
                        <div class="popup-characters"><strong>${t('map.keyFigures', 'Key figures:')}</strong> ${evt.characters}</div>
                        ${PLACE_PAGES[evt.id] ? `<div class="popup-more"><a href="/places/${PLACE_PAGES[evt.id]}/">${t('map.readAbout', 'Read about this place')} →</a></div>` : ''}
                    </div>
                `, { maxWidth: 300, autoPanPaddingTopLeft: L.point(10, 54) });

            marker._eventData = evt;
            categoryLayers[evt.category].addLayer(marker);
        });

        Object.values(categoryLayers).forEach(layer => layer.addTo(map));

        // Which locations people actually open
        map.on('popupopen', (e) => {
            const evt = e.popup._source && e.popup._source._eventData;
            if (evt) track('marker_open', { me_event: evt.name, category: evt.category });
        });

        // Catmull-Rom spline interpolation for smooth journey paths
        // Only interpolate segments longer than minDist to avoid loops on close points
        // Points with a truthy third element (e.g. [x, y, 1]) are always smoothed
        function smoothPoints(points, segments = 6, minDist = 100) {
            if (points.length < 3) return points;
            const result = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
                const p1 = points[i];
                const p2 = points[i + 1];
                const forceSmooth = p1[2] && p2[2];
                if (!forceSmooth) {
                    const dx = p2[0] - p1[0];
                    const dy = p2[1] - p1[1];
                    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                    if (dist < minDist) {
                        result.push(p1);
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                const p0 = points[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
                const p3 = points[Math.min(points.length - 1, i + 2)];
                for (let t = 0; t < segments; t++) {
                    const tt = t / segments;
                    const tt2 = tt * tt;
                    const tt3 = tt2 * tt;
                    result.push([
                        0.5 * ((2*p1[0]) + (-p0[0]+p2[0])*tt + (2*p0[0]-5*p1[0]+4*p2[0]-p3[0])*tt2 + (-p0[0]+3*p1[0]-3*p2[0]+p3[0])*tt3),
                        0.5 * ((2*p1[1]) + (-p0[1]+p2[1])*tt + (2*p0[1]-5*p1[1]+4*p2[1]-p3[1])*tt2 + (-p0[1]+3*p1[1]-3*p2[1]+p3[1])*tt3)
                    ]);
                }
            }
            result.push(points[points.length - 1]);
            return result;
        }

        const journeyLayers = {};

        Object.keys(JOURNEYS).forEach(key => {
            const journey = JOURNEYS[key];
            const lines = [];
            const smoothed = smoothPoints(journey.points);
            const latlngs = smoothed.map(([px, py]) => toLatLng(px, py));
            lines.push(L.polyline(latlngs, {
                color: journey.color,
                weight: 3,
                dashArray: '10 6',
                opacity: 0.7,
                className: 'journey-path'
            }));
            if (journey.branches) {
                Object.values(journey.branches).forEach(branch => {
                    const branchPoints = Array.isArray(branch) ? branch : branch.points;
                    const branchColor = Array.isArray(branch) ? journey.color : (branch.color || journey.color);
                    const smoothedBranch = smoothPoints(branchPoints);
                    const branchLatLngs = smoothedBranch.map(([px, py]) => toLatLng(px, py));
                    lines.push(L.polyline(branchLatLngs, {
                        color: branchColor,
                        weight: 3,
                        dashArray: '10 6',
                        opacity: 0.7,
                        className: 'journey-path'
                    }));
                });
            }
            journeyLayers[key] = L.layerGroup(lines);
        });

        // ── Legend ───────────────────────────────────────
        const legendEl = document.getElementById('legend-content');

        // ── Journey Toggles (top of legend) ───────────
        const journeyHeader = document.createElement('div');
        journeyHeader.className = 'legend-section-header';
        const journeyTitle = document.createElement('div');
        journeyTitle.className = 'legend-journeys-title';
        journeyTitle.textContent = t('legend.journeys', 'Journeys');
        const journeyClearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        journeyClearBtn.className = 'legend-section-toggle';
        journeyClearBtn.textContent = t('legend.showAll', 'show all');
        journeyHeader.appendChild(journeyTitle);
        journeyHeader.appendChild(journeyClearBtn);
        legendEl.appendChild(journeyHeader);

        const journeyToggles = [];
        const journeyToggleByKey = {};

        // Single place where a journey goes on or off, so the legend and the
        // ?journey= deep link cannot disagree. source=null means "set up the
        // view", which should not be reported as a user action.
        function setJourney(key, on, source) {
            const toggle = journeyToggleByKey[key];
            if (!toggle) return;
            toggle.classList.toggle('disabled', !on);
            if (on) map.addLayer(journeyLayers[key]);
            else map.removeLayer(journeyLayers[key]);
            updateJourneyClearBtn();
            if (source) {
                track('journey_toggle', {
                    // English on purpose: a translated value would fragment reporting
                    journey: JOURNEYS[key].label,
                    state: on ? 'on' : 'off'
                });
            }
        }

        Object.keys(JOURNEYS).forEach(key => {
            const journey = JOURNEYS[key];
            const toggle = document.createElement('div');
            toggle.className = 'journey-toggle disabled';
            toggle.dataset.key = key;
            toggle.innerHTML = `
                <div class="journey-line" style="border-color: ${journey.color};"></div>
                <span class="journey-label">${t('journeys.' + key, journey.label)}</span>
            `;
            toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                setJourney(key, toggle.classList.contains('disabled'), 'legend');
            });
            journeyToggles.push(toggle);
            journeyToggleByKey[key] = toggle;
            legendEl.appendChild(toggle);
        });

        function updateJourneyClearBtn() {
            const anyEnabled = journeyToggles.some(t => !t.classList.contains('disabled'));
            journeyClearBtn.textContent = anyEnabled
                ? t('legend.clearAll', 'clear all')
                : t('legend.showAll', 'show all');
        }

        journeyClearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const anyEnabled = journeyToggles.some(t => !t.classList.contains('disabled'));
            journeyToggles.forEach(toggle => {
                const key = toggle.dataset.key;
                if (anyEnabled) {
                    toggle.classList.add('disabled');
                    map.removeLayer(journeyLayers[key]);
                } else {
                    toggle.classList.remove('disabled');
                    map.addLayer(journeyLayers[key]);
                }
            });
            updateJourneyClearBtn();
        });

        const divider = document.createElement('hr');
        divider.className = 'legend-divider';
        legendEl.appendChild(divider);

        // ── Book Categories ────────────────────────────
        const eventsHeader = document.createElement('div');
        eventsHeader.className = 'legend-section-header';
        const eventsTitle = document.createElement('div');
        eventsTitle.className = 'legend-journeys-title';
        eventsTitle.textContent = t('legend.events', 'Events');
        const eventsClearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        eventsClearBtn.className = 'legend-section-toggle';
        eventsClearBtn.textContent = t('legend.clearAll', 'clear all');
        eventsHeader.appendChild(eventsTitle);
        eventsHeader.appendChild(eventsClearBtn);
        legendEl.appendChild(eventsHeader);

        const categoryDivs = [];
        const categoryDivByCat = {};

        // As with journeys: one setter shared by the legend and the ?book=
        // deep link that the Hobbit and Silmarillion pages send visitors to.
        function setCategory(cat, on, source) {
            const div = categoryDivByCat[cat];
            if (!div) return;
            div.classList.toggle('disabled', !on);
            const toggle = div.querySelector('.legend-toggle');
            if (on) {
                map.addLayer(categoryLayers[cat]);
                toggle.innerHTML = '▼';
            } else {
                map.removeLayer(categoryLayers[cat]);
                toggle.innerHTML = '▶';
            }
            updateEventsClearBtn();
            if (source) track('category_toggle', { category: cat, state: on ? 'on' : 'off' });
        }

        Object.keys(CATEGORY_LABELS).forEach(cat => {
            const catEvents = events.filter(e => e.category === cat);

            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = 'legend-category';
            div.dataset.category = cat;

            div.innerHTML = `
                <div class="legend-category-header">
                    <div class="legend-dot" style="background: ${COLORS[cat]};"></div>
                    <span class="legend-category-label">${t('books.' + cat, CATEGORY_LABELS[cat])}</span>
                    <span class="legend-toggle">▼</span>
                </div>
                <div class="legend-items">
                    ${catEvents.map((e, i) => `<div class="legend-item" data-index="${events.indexOf(e)}">${e.name.split('—')[0].trim()}</div>`).join('')}
                </div>
            `;

            // Toggle category visibility
            div.querySelector('.legend-category-header').addEventListener('click', () => {
                setCategory(cat, div.classList.contains('disabled'), 'legend');
            });

            // Click legend item to fly to marker
            div.querySelectorAll('.legend-item').forEach(item => {
                item.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const evt = events[parseInt(item.dataset.index)];
                    const latlng = toLatLng(evt.px, evt.py);
                    map.flyTo(latlng, 1, { duration: 0.8 });
                    track('legend_event_click', { me_event: evt.name, category: evt.category });

                    // Open the popup
                    categoryLayers[evt.category].eachLayer(marker => {
                        if (marker._eventData === evt) {
                            setTimeout(() => marker.openPopup(), 400);
                        }
                    });
                });
            });

            categoryDivs.push(div);
            categoryDivByCat[cat] = div;
            legendEl.appendChild(div);
        });

        function updateEventsClearBtn() {
            const anyEnabled = categoryDivs.some(d => !d.classList.contains('disabled'));
            eventsClearBtn.textContent = anyEnabled
                ? t('legend.clearAll', 'clear all')
                : t('legend.showAll', 'show all');
        }

        eventsClearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const anyEnabled = categoryDivs.some(d => !d.classList.contains('disabled'));
            categoryDivs.forEach(div => {
                const cat = div.dataset.category;
                const toggle = div.querySelector('.legend-toggle');
                if (anyEnabled) {
                    div.classList.add('disabled');
                    map.removeLayer(categoryLayers[cat]);
                    toggle.innerHTML = '▶';
                } else {
                    div.classList.remove('disabled');
                    map.addLayer(categoryLayers[cat]);
                    toggle.innerHTML = '▼';
                }
            });
            updateEventsClearBtn();
        });

        // ── Coordinate Toggle (bottom of legend) ──────
        const coordDivider = document.createElement('hr');
        coordDivider.className = 'legend-divider';
        legendEl.appendChild(coordDivider);

        let coordsEnabled = true;
        const coordToggleRow = document.createElement('div');
        coordToggleRow.className = 'coord-toggle-row active';
        coordToggleRow.innerHTML = `
            <div class="coord-toggle-switch"></div>
            <span class="coord-toggle-label">${t('legend.showCoordinates', 'Show coordinates')}</span>
        `;
        coordToggleRow.addEventListener('click', () => {
            coordsEnabled = !coordsEnabled;
            coordToggleRow.classList.toggle('active', coordsEnabled);
            if (!coordsEnabled) {
                coordDisplay.style.display = 'none';
            }
            track('coords_toggle', { state: coordsEnabled ? 'on' : 'off' });
        });
        legendEl.appendChild(coordToggleRow);

        // ── Distance Measure Tool ───────────────────
        const PIXELS_PER_MILE = 4.05;
        const MILES_PER_LEAGUE = 3;

        let measureEnabled = false;
        let measurePoints = [];
        let measureLayers = [];
        const measureDisplay = document.getElementById('measure-display');

        const measureToggleRow = document.createElement('div');
        measureToggleRow.className = 'coord-toggle-row';
        measureToggleRow.innerHTML = `
            <div class="coord-toggle-switch"></div>
            <span class="coord-toggle-label">${t('legend.measureDistance', 'Measure distance')}</span>
        `;
        measureToggleRow.addEventListener('click', () => {
            measureEnabled = !measureEnabled;
            measureToggleRow.classList.toggle('active', measureEnabled);
            document.body.classList.toggle('measure-active', measureEnabled);
            if (!measureEnabled) clearMeasure();
            track('measure_toggle', { state: measureEnabled ? 'on' : 'off' });
        });
        legendEl.appendChild(measureToggleRow);

        // ── Satellite View Toggle ─────────────────────
        const satToggleRow = document.createElement('div');
        satToggleRow.className = 'coord-toggle-row';
        satToggleRow.innerHTML = `
            <div class="coord-toggle-switch"></div>
            <span class="coord-toggle-label">${t('legend.satelliteView', 'Satellite view')}</span>
        `;
        // The legend row and the bottom-centre button drive the same state,
        // so either control reflects a change made with the other.
        const satBtn = document.getElementById('sat-btn');
        const satBtnIcon = document.getElementById('sat-btn-icon');
        const satBtnLabel = document.getElementById('sat-btn-label');
        let satActive = false;

        function setSatellite(active, source) {
            satActive = active;
            if (active) {
                map.removeLayer(mapTiles);
                map.addLayer(satTiles);
            } else {
                map.removeLayer(satTiles);
                map.addLayer(mapTiles);
            }
            satToggleRow.classList.toggle('active', active);
            satBtn.classList.toggle('active', active);
            satBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');

            // The button is labelled with the layer it switches to, so in
            // satellite view it offers the parchment map back. The data-i18n
            // key moves with it, so a late i18nApply() writes the right string.
            const key = active ? 'controls.parchmentMap' : 'controls.satellite';
            satBtnLabel.setAttribute('data-i18n', key);
            satBtnLabel.textContent = active
                ? t('controls.parchmentMap', 'Parchment map')
                : t('controls.satellite', 'Satellite');
            satBtnIcon.innerHTML = active ? '🗺︎' : '🛰︎';

            track('satellite_toggle', { state: active ? 'on' : 'off', source });
        }

        satToggleRow.addEventListener('click', () => setSatellite(!satActive, 'legend'));
        satBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setSatellite(!satActive, 'map_control'));
        document.getElementById('story-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            track('story_open', { source: 'map_control' });
        });
        legendEl.appendChild(satToggleRow);

        function clearMeasure() {
            measurePoints = [];
            measureLayers.forEach(l => map.removeLayer(l));
            measureLayers = [];
            measureDisplay.style.display = 'none';
        }

        map.on('click', function(e) {
            if (!measureEnabled) return;

            // Third click — clear and start fresh
            if (measurePoints.length >= 2) clearMeasure();

            measurePoints.push(e.latlng);

            // Place circle marker at clicked point
            const circle = L.circleMarker(e.latlng, {
                radius: 5,
                color: '#c9a435',
                fillColor: '#c9a435',
                fillOpacity: 0.8,
                weight: 2
            }).addTo(map);
            measureLayers.push(circle);

            // Second click — draw line and show distance
            if (measurePoints.length === 2) {
                const line = L.polyline(measurePoints, {
                    color: '#c9a435',
                    weight: 2,
                    dashArray: '8 6',
                    opacity: 0.8
                }).addTo(map);
                measureLayers.push(line);

                const pxA = measurePoints[0];
                const pxB = measurePoints[1];
                const dx = pxA.lng - pxB.lng;
                const dy = pxA.lat - pxB.lat;
                const pxDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                const miles = pxDist / PIXELS_PER_MILE;
                const leagues = miles / MILES_PER_LEAGUE;

                measureDisplay.textContent = t('map.measureReadout',
                    'A \u2192 B: {miles} miles ({leagues} leagues)',
                    { miles: Math.round(miles), leagues: leagues.toFixed(1) });
                measureDisplay.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });

        // ── Legend Collapse ────────────────────
        const legend = document.getElementById('legend');
        const collapseBtn = document.getElementById('collapse-btn');
        const legendClose = document.getElementById('legend-close');

        function hideLegend() {
            legend.style.display = 'none';
            collapseBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function showLegend() {
            legend.style.display = 'block';
            collapseBtn.style.display = 'none';
        }

        legendClose.addEventListener('click', hideLegend);
        collapseBtn.addEventListener('click', showLegend);

        // Auto-collapse on mobile
        if (window.innerWidth < 600) {
            hideLegend();
        }

        // Close legend on map click (mobile)
        map.on('click', () => {
            if (window.innerWidth < 600) {
                hideLegend();
            }
        });

        // ── Coordinate Picker (calibration tool) ────────
        const coordDisplay = document.createElement('div');
        coordDisplay.id = 'coord-display';   // styled by the #coord-display rule
        document.body.appendChild(coordDisplay);

        map.on('click', function(e) {
            if (!coordsEnabled) return;
            const px = Math.round(e.latlng.lng);
            const py = Math.round(e.latlng.lat);
            coordDisplay.style.display = 'block';
            coordDisplay.textContent = t('map.coordReadout', 'px: {px}, py: {py}', { px: px, py: py });
            console.log(`{ px: ${px}, py: ${py} }`);
        });

        map.on('contextmenu', function(e) {
            if (!coordsEnabled) return;
            const px = Math.round(e.latlng.lng);
            const py = Math.round(e.latlng.lat);
            const text = `px: ${px}, py: ${py}`;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            coordDisplay.style.display = 'block';
            coordDisplay.textContent = t('map.copiedSuffix', '{text}  (copied)', { text: text });
        });

        // ── Toast auto-hide ─────────────────────────────
        // Whichever comes first: five seconds, or the first sign that the
        // visitor has worked out how to move the map. Hiding on interaction
        // also keeps it from ever sharing the lower screen with the
        // coordinate and measurement readouts, which only appear on a click.
        (function () {
            const toastEl = document.getElementById('toast');
            const hideToast = () => toastEl.classList.add('hidden');
            setTimeout(hideToast, 5000);
            // Real input only. Leaflet's movestart/zoomstart also fire for the
            // opening fitBounds(), which would retire the hint before it is read.
            const container = map.getContainer();
            ['mousedown', 'touchstart', 'wheel'].forEach(function (evt) {
                container.addEventListener(evt, hideToast, { once: true, passive: true });
            });
        })();

        // ── Utility: darken a hex color ─────────────────
        function darken(hex, amount) {
            hex = hex.replace('#', '');
            const r = Math.max(0, parseInt(hex.substring(0, 2), 16) - amount);
            const g = Math.max(0, parseInt(hex.substring(2, 4), 16) - amount);
            const b = Math.max(0, parseInt(hex.substring(4, 6), 16) - amount);
            return `#${r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        }

        // ── Cross-page navigation (from timeline) ─────
        (function() {
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const fly = params.get('fly');
            const eventName = params.get('event');
            if (fly) {
                track('deep_link_arrival', { me_event: eventName || '(unnamed)' });
                const [px, py] = fly.split(',').map(Number);
                const latlng = toLatLng(px, py);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    map.flyTo(latlng, 1, { duration: 1.2 });
                    if (eventName) {
                        Object.values(categoryLayers).forEach(layer => {
                            layer.eachLayer(marker => {
                                if (marker.getPopup() && marker.getPopup().getContent().includes(eventName)) {
                                    setTimeout(() => marker.openPopup(), 1200);
                                }
                            });
                        });
                    }
                }, 500);
            }

            // ?book=hobbit narrows the map to one book. This is where the
            // Hobbit and Silmarillion landing pages send visitors, so the view
            // has to arrive already focused on that book's places.
            const book = params.get('book');
            if (book && categoryLayers[book]) {
                Object.keys(CATEGORY_LABELS).forEach(cat => setCategory(cat, cat === book, null));
                const pts = events.filter(e => e.category === book).map(e => toLatLng(e.px, e.py));
                if (pts.length && !params.get('fly')) {
                    map.fitBounds(L.latLngBounds(pts).pad(0.12));
                }
                track('book_filter_arrival', { category: book });
            }

            // ?journey=bilbo draws one route. Journeys are all off by default,
            // so this adds rather than replaces.
            const journeyParam = params.get('journey');
            if (journeyParam) {
                journeyParam.split(',').forEach(key => {
                    key = key.trim();
                    if (JOURNEYS[key]) setJourney(key, true, null);
                });
                track('journey_deep_link', { journey: journeyParam });
            }

            // ?view=satellite activates satellite tiles on load
            if (params.get('view') === 'satellite') {
                setSatellite(true, 'deep_link');
            }
        })();

        // ── Splash Screen ────────────────────────────────
        (function() {
            const overlay = document.getElementById('splash-overlay');
            const enterBtn = document.getElementById('splash-enter');
            const infoBtn = document.getElementById('info-btn');

            function showSplash() {
                overlay.style.display = 'flex';
                // Force reflow so transition triggers
                overlay.offsetHeight;
                overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
            }

            function hideSplash() {
                overlay.classList.add('hidden');
                localStorage.setItem('me-map-welcomed', '1');
                overlay.addEventListener('transitionend', function handler() {
                    overlay.style.display = 'none';
                    overlay.removeEventListener('transitionend', handler);
                });
            }

            if (!localStorage.getItem('me-map-welcomed')) {
                showSplash();
                track('splash_shown');
            }

            enterBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                hideSplash();
                track('splash_dismissed');
            });
            infoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                showSplash();
                track('info_opened');
            });
        })();

    </script>
</body>
</html>
